en: A set of 5 characters that appear in "SD Gundam Force": "Heavy Weapon Captain Gundam", "GF Ball", "GF Jim", "Gun Biker", "Zako Soldier x 2, Zako Soldier Bone". Captain Gundam is pearl colored.
